entries.reason: The Cognito message trigger (lib/stacks/core-auth.ts) installs its own copy of voc-datalake/lambda/layers/signing-deps for cryptography (the invitation logo's CloudFront signature); since 7.05.00 that directory also pins pypdf, the projects API's Documents Library reader (shared/library_extract.py). One requirements file keeps the two copies the same versions; the trigger never imports pypdf.
